versions.description_html:
Discover what Microsoft Teams Rooms are, how meeting spaces sign into Teams independently, and the differences between Windows, Android, Basic, and Pro.

Your meeting room has its own Microsoft 365 account, and nobody told you. A Microsoft Teams Room is a meeting space where the room itself signs into Teams, so nobody has to plug in a laptop.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What a Teams Room Really Is
  • What's Inside the Room
  • How the Room Knows Your Meeting
  • Windows or Android
  • Basic, Pro, and the Portal
  • Rooms That Actually Work
  • Keeping the Fleet Alive
  • The Recap and a Question

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
